title: Atomic WOFOST Crop-Owner Publication and Accepted-Event Consumption Transaction
problem: F-WOF37 qualifies the accepted physical window through deterministic WOFOST crop-candidate construction, but the current F-WOF34 event_delivered mutation and crop-owner publication are separate ownership surfaces. A production sequence of two independent commits is not transactionally atomic.

source_bound_basis.finding: wofost_crop_owner_state_t already extends transaction_state_t and has deep clone semantics.
F-KT is already qualified as the sole transaction authority for the atomic actual-WOFOST crop owner; direct F-KT initialization/checkpoint/discard/replay of the crop owner was qualified.
F-KT creates opaque provenance-bound candidates through kernel_advance_interval and publishes them through kernel_commit_candidate; no arbitrary external candidate adoption is required.
The accepted window can prepare frozen aggregates plus an opaque event token. Its existing commit_wofost_crop_event_delivery mutates only event_delivered and does not publish crop state.

TX_TEMPORAL_MODEL_CERTIFICATE allows a model-owned single full trial without mandatory full-versus-two-half crop execution; this is required because the currently qualified WOFOST event is one explicit crop day and arbitrary half-day crop evolution is not admitted.

The qualified first crop evolution event is one explicit B1.10-equivalent crop day scheduled outside the kernel; WOFOST must not be called on each Richards substep or silently refined into half-day crop events.

selected_architecture.name: WOFOST_SPECIFIC_FKT_TRANSACTION_PARTICIPANT_WITH_SOURCE_EVENT_RECEIPT
selected_architecture.runtime_state: A small WOFOST-specific transaction_state_t wrapper owns the physical wofost_crop_owner_state_t plus the identity of the last accepted physical event consumed by that crop state.
selected_architecture.event_identity: A compact opaque source-event identity derived inside the accepted-window lineage module from its existing crop-event token. It identifies source physical lineage/final revision and event interval; aggregate/token consistency remains validated by the lineage producer path.
selected_architecture.transaction_model: A WOFOST-specific kernel_model_t consumes one frozen accepted-event payload and executes the already-qualified F-WOF33 two-phase one-day crop window on a cloned committed crop transaction state.
selected_architecture.publication: On successful trial, the candidate contains both the new crop owner and the consumed source-event identity. kernel_commit_candidate publishes them together by one F-KT state replacement.
selected_architecture.delivery_acknowledgment: For the F-WOF38 composed route, accepted-event consumption is derived from the committed crop transaction receipt. The existing F-WOF34 event_delivered bit is not a second publication authority and must not be independently committed in this route.
selected_architecture.duplicate_prevention: A replay of the same source-event identity is rejected before crop mutation; F-KT time/revision provenance provides an additional stale/replay guard.

why_not_modify_wofost_crop_owner_state: The crop owner remains physical/continuation state. Source-event consumption provenance is runtime transaction metadata and is therefore kept in a runtime wrapper rather than mixed into the crop physics owner.
why_not_generic_kernel_extension: A generic arbitrary external kernel-candidate adoption API would weaken the opaque F-KT provenance contract. F-WOF38 instead implements the normal kernel_model_t path already provided by F-KT.

temporal_policy.qualified_event: exactly one currently admitted WOFOST crop day
temporal_policy.reason: Failure of a fixed crop event must be retried from the same committed crop checkpoint with corrected/identical accepted-event input, not silently converted to a shorter crop-evolution event.

mass_policy.note: The crop transaction does not own Richards water storage. Accepted QROT/PTRA values are immutable input evidence already qualified on the physical-water transaction. F-WOF38 must not re-account or alter water mass.

initial_qualification_scope.atomicity: in-memory F-KT transaction atomicity and checkpoint/retry/replay

planned_production_delta: one additive opaque accepted-event identity/comparison API in src/runtime/mod_fmr_wofost_accepted_window_lineage.f90
one new runtime WOFOST crop transaction state/model module
hard_non_solutions: commit event_delivered first and crop owner second
commit crop owner first and event_delivered second
expose a generic arbitrary external kernel_candidate_state_t adoption helper
treat failed one-day crop evolution as permission to run half-day crop evolution
store the whole accepted physical window permanently in every crop column
qualification_gates: Gate A: additive event-identity API preserves the exact F-WOF34 transcript and F-WOF36 physical binding
Gate B: crop transaction state deep-clones owner plus receipt and remains compact/optional
Gate C: one F-KT advance+commit publishes crop candidate plus receipt together from one accepted event
Gate D: failed crop begin/phase-B/finalize leaves committed owner and receipt bitwise unchanged
Gate E: rejected attempt followed by accepted retry publishes exactly once from the same committed checkpoint
Gate F: duplicate source-event replay produces zero extra crop advancement and zero second receipt transition
Gate G: same checkpoint + same event replays bitwise-identical F-KT candidate before commit
Gate H: O0/O2 output identity and unchanged F-WOF37/F-WOF36/F-WOF34 regression
Gate I: no kernel source change, no calendar/file-I/O dependency, no new root/ET/Richards physics
